title: Makan Mana?
subject: a couple of five years stuck in a parked Myvi at eight at night unable to decide where to eat, ending at the same nasi lemak stall as always
caption: Malay conversational duet pop in the mid-tempo 2025 duet style. A fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carrying the groove; an upright piano comping short chords; a brushed drum kit with a soft kick; a warm electric bass; a light string quartet entering only on the last chorus. Intimate and dry, the two voices panned slightly apart, the guitar forward. Male and female duet, both mid register, trading lines like a real conversation and singing the chorus together in close harmony. 96 BPM, E major. Playful, bickering and fond. No slow power-ballad build, no belting climax, no trap beat, no autotune, no EDM.
lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1 - Duet, trading lines]
Sayang, nak makan mana malam ni?
Ikut awak, saya tak kisah
Kedai Thai kat Seksyen Tujuh?
Pedas sangat, perut saya tak larat

[Pre-Chorus]
Enjin hidup, kereta tak gerak
Kipas aircond pun dah penat

[Chorus - Duet]
Makan mana, makan mana
Lima tahun soalan yang sama
Lapar tapi masih ketawa
Dengan awak, mana-mana pun boleh

[Verse 2 - Duet, trading lines]
Burger tepi jalan?
Semalam dah makan
Sushi kat mall?
Parking penuh, tak nak

[Pre-Chorus]
Pukul sembilan, perut berbunyi
Okey, kita pergi tempat tu lagi

[Chorus - Duet, strings enter]
Makan mana, makan mana
Nasi lemak Kak Yah juga akhirnya
Telur mata, sambal lebih
Dengan awak, tempat yang sama pun cukup

[Outro - guitar and both voices]
Esok tanya lagi
Esok jawab lagi
